title: game/nouns.json
description: The noun catalogue: each target-language noun the game names, the item kinds and block kinds it stands for. Loaded by NounCatalog (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

lemma.description: The noun's lemma; the lexicon must have a noun reading of it with a gender.

items.description: The item kinds the noun names; each item kind belongs to one noun.

blocks.description: The block kinds the noun names.

labels.description: The text that labels one of the noun's items when it is not the lemma (roast-apple: manzana asada).

mass.description: A mass noun: the checklist shows the lemma, never the plural.

sources.description: The catalogue nouns this one is gathered from (madera from árbol).

item.description: An item kind, by its stable name (a row of game/items.json; the content check refuses a name the catalogue lacks).

block.description: A block kind, by its stable name (BlockDefinition).
